correctness.rationale: Each absent interior edge is exactly a local-max gap; n+1 iid exponential spacings yield the unit-interval law. Independence of total exponential mass and normalized vector transfers covariance to rank-weighted peak sums. On-site, adjacent and distance-two mixed covariances are 11/27, -11/54 and 139/5400, and longer ranges are independent, proving every n boundary case. Exhaustive exact-fraction checks of graph construction and covariance through n=9 independently reproduce the formula.

value.rationale: The exact dependence between component count (fragmentation) and undirected distinct-edge length (cost) is structurally meaningful, remains strictly negative for all n≥4, and has an explicit nonvanishing large-n covariance. The distinction between directed and distinct-edge lengths matters mathematically, and the rational finite-size law is not obtained just from known first moments.
